slot_scores.name: van_ev_mutual_exclusion
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether vans and electric vehicles are mutually exclusive or can be used together; the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits this constraint entirely.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_pollution_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What should the objective be — minimize total pollution, minimize total cost (if there is a cost per trip), minimize total number of trips, or something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and included minimizing total pollution as an option, fully covering the hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Both vans and electric vehicles can be used simultaneously without any mutual-exclusivity restriction.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the van/EV mutual-exclusion constraint, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists all four vehicle types as decision variables and omits the restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL after resolving the P0 objective slot, but the P1 van/EV mutual-exclusion slot remained unresolved and was silently omitted.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective and several modeling details, but failed to ask about the van/EV mutual-exclusion constraint and stopped with that P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
